title: Daria Asks Again
recap: Daria forgot the steps for her project.

slides.text: On Wednesday, Daria's teacher started giving instructions for a project.
The teacher was standing at the whiteboard.
Daria could not remember all the steps.
Daria raised her hand and asked the teacher to repeat the steps.
The teacher said the steps one more time so Daria could try again.
